notes: Three horizontal rails (top y~152, middle y~239, bottom y~340) tied together by four vertical diode columns at x~159, x~249, x~348 and x~421; each rail is broken into segments by series parts, each column has one diode/zener above the middle rail and one below it. Judgment calls: (a) GND 17 (middle rail, left) and GND 14 (below Resistor 6) are drawn as two separate symbols but by the single-reference rule both nets are named 0; Resistor 6 therefore sits between n5 and 0 and is the only element bridging those two, which is the electrically sensible reading (it is the load returning the middle rail to ground). (b) All 2-terminal parts are listed as drawn: horizontal parts left-lead-then-right-lead, vertical parts top-lead-then-bottom-lead; order does not affect any metric, and no diode/zener orientation changes the net grouping. (c) Capacitor 16 sits IN the top rail (series), not as a shunt - verified at 7x, its plates are vertical and the rail enters the left plate and leaves the right plate; same for Capacitor 15 in the middle rail, Capacitor 18 in the bottom rail, and Inductors 7 / 1 / 11. (d) The top rail terminates at x~416 by turning down into Diode 8 - it does not continue to the right edge; the bottom rail likewise terminates at x~429 by turning up into Diode 5.
